description: This source file implements the core logic for managing WAN modes within a network management system. It includes functions for getting and setting WAN modes, configuring interface IP modes, handling events related to WAN configuration changes, and integrating with the underlying data model. The file also manages autosensing and network selector initialization and cleanup, and provides external interfaces for controlling WAN modes.
